38:1: Sad. By the Quran possessing the reminder.
38:2: Rather, those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
38:3: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out, whereas it was no longer a time of escape.
38:4: They marveled that a warner had come to them from among themselves, and the disbelievers said: This is a lying sorcerer.
38:5: Has he made the gods a single god? Indeed, this is truly an astonishing thing.
38:6: The notables among them walked forth and said: Persevere against your gods; indeed, this is a thing intended.
38:7: We did not hear of this in the latest religion; this is nothing but an invention.
38:8: Was the reminder sent down to him from among us? Nay, they are in doubt about My reminder. Nay, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
38:9: Or are the treasures of the mercy of your Rabb, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving, with them?
38:10: Or is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them theirs? Then let them ascend in the means.
38:11: There is a defeated army from the factions there.
38:12: Before them, the people of Noah, 'Ad, and Pharaoh, owner of the stakes, denied.
38:13: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the companions of al-Aykah too. Those are the factions.
38:14: Indeed, all of them did not but deny the messengers, so the punishment became justified.
38:15: They await nothing but a single cry, for which there is no delay.
38:16: They said: Our Rabb, hasten for us our share before the Day of Reckoning.
38:17: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant David, possessor of strength; indeed, he is one who turns much.
38:18: Indeed, We subjected the mountains to glorify with him in the evening and at mid-morning.
38:19: And the birds gathered together, each one turning to Him.
38:20: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment of speech.
38:21: Has the news of the adversaries reached you? When they climbed over the sanctuary.
38:22: When they entered upon David, and he was frightened of them. They said: Do not fear, two litigants, one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us with truth.
38:23: Indeed, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes, and I have a single ewe. (He) said: Give it to me, and he overpowered me in speech.
38:24: He said: 'By oath, he has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe to add to his ewes. And indeed, most partners wrong one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, and how few they are!' David thought that We had surely tested him, so he asked forgiveness of his Rabb, fell down prostrating in ruku, and turned to Him.
38:25: So We forgave him that, and indeed, for him with Us is nearness and a good place of return.
38:26: O David! Indeed, We have made you a successor upon the earth. So judge between the people with truth and do not follow desire, lest it mislead you from the way of Allah. Indeed, for those who stray from the way of Allah there is a severe punishment because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
38:27: We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. Woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire!
38:28: Or do We make those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the earth, or do We make the muttaqeen like the wicked?
38:29: A blessed Book which We have sent down to you, so that they may ponder its verses and that those of understanding may take heed.
38:30: And to David We bestowed Solomon. What an excellent servant he was! Indeed, he was one who turned much.
38:31: When there were displayed before him in the afternoon standing thoroughbred horses.
38:32: Thereupon he said: Indeed, I have loved the love of good for the sake of the remembrance of my Rabb, until it was hidden by the veil.
38:33: Bring them back to me, then he began to stroke legs and necks.
38:34: And by oath, We tried Solomon and placed a body upon his throne, then he turned.
38:35: He said: 'My Rabb, forgive me and grant me a dominion that will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Much-Bestowing.'
38:36: Thereupon We subjected the wind to him; it blew gently by his command wherever he wished.
38:37: And every builder and diver of the devils as well.
38:39: This is Our gift; so give or withhold without account.
38:40: And indeed, for him with Us is nearness and a good place of return.
38:41: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Rabb: Satan has touched me with distress and torment.
38:42: Strike with your foot; here is cold water for washing and drinking, We say.
38:43: And We bestowed upon him his family and the like of them with them, as a mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
38:44: And take in your hand a bundle, strike with it, and do not break your oath. Indeed, We found him patient. What an excellent servant he was! Indeed, he was one who turned much.
38:45: And remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of hands and eyes.
38:46: Indeed, We made them pure with a pure quality: the remembrance of the home of the Hereafter.
38:47: And indeed, in Our sight they are among the chosen, the best.
38:48: And remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl; all are of the good.
38:49: This is a reminder, and indeed, for the righteous there is a good place of return.
38:50: Gardens of 'Adn for them, with doors opened.
38:51: Reclining therein, they call for abundant fruit and drink.
38:52: And with them are those of equal age with their gazes fixed on their spouses.
38:53: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
38:54: Indeed, this is Our provision, which has no exhaustion.
38:55: This [is so], and for the transgressors indeed there is an evil place of return.
38:56: Hell, which they enter—what an evil resting place!
38:57: This is boiling water and purulence, so let them taste it.
38:59: This is a crowd rushing along with you. No welcome for them! Indeed, they will enter the Fire.
38:60: They said: "Rather, no welcome for you! You brought this upon us beforehand. What an evil abode!"
38:61: They said: "Our Rabb! Whoever brought this upon us beforehand, increase his punishment manifold in the Fire."
38:62: And they said: "What is the matter with us that we do not see men whom we used to count among the evil ones?"
38:63: Did we take them in mockery, or have eyes swerved from them?
38:64: Indeed, that is a reality—the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
38:65: Say: "I am only a warner, and there is no deity except Allah, the One, al-Qahhar."
38:66: Rabb of the heavens, the earth, and what is between them, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
38:69: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly when they were disputing.
38:70: It is only revealed to me that I am only a clear warner.
38:71: When your Rabb said to the angels: "I am creating a human being from clay.
38:72: When I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration to him.
38:73: So the angels prostrated, all of them together.
38:74: Except Iblis; he acted arrogantly and became of the disbelievers.
38:75: He said: "O Iblis! What prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My two hands? Did you act arrogantly, or were you of the exalted ones?"
38:76: He said: I am better than him. You created me from fire, and him You created from clay.
38:77: He said: "Then get out of there, because you are expelled.
38:78: And surely My curse is upon you until the Day of Judgment.
38:79: He said: My Rabb, grant me respite until the day they are resurrected.
38:80: He said: Surely you are of those granted respite of the known day.
38:81: Until the day of the known time.
38:82: He said: 'By Your might, I will surely lead all of them astray.'
38:83: Except Your servants, the ones chosen from among them
38:84: He said: The truth is that which is right, and I speak the truth.
38:85: I will fill Hell with you and with all of those from among them who follow you.
38:86: Say: I do not ask of you any fee in return for this, and I am not of those who claim something of their own accord.
38:87: It is only a reminder for the worlds.
38:88: And you will surely know its news after a time.
